name: edloidas-workflow
description: A Codex-safe workflow bundle: take a GitHub issue from analysis to merged, orchestrate a batch of issues and pull requests through subagents, or triage a review queue or the issue backlog.

interface.shortDescription: End-to-end issue workflow, orchestration, and review and backlog triage.
interface.longDescription: Install the workflow bundle from edloidas/skills to take a GitHub issue end to end from Codex — analyze, plan, implement, verify, adversarially review, clean up, commit, and ship — to coordinate many issues and pull requests through worker subagents, or to triage the pull requests waiting on you and the open issue backlog.
